Guerneville, California · eat

Restaurants in Guerneville for cyclists

Where to eat in Guerneville the night before and the afternoon after. Real food, open when you need it.

For: Cycle to Zero.

Restaurants in Guerneville for cyclists, listed

  1. Piknik Town Market

    Breakfast and lunch on Main Street: a market with baked goods, salads and grab-and-go food.

    • Market
    • 16228 Main Street, Guerneville, CA 95446
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Piknik Town Market

    Opens 8 a.m. every day; closes 5 p.m. Saturday and 4 p.m. the other six (its own page, Nov 2026). Its page says nothing about tables, inside or out. (707) 604-7295.

  2. Guerneville Taco Truck

    Tacos, burritos and a breakfast burrito from a truck in town.

    • Mexican
    • 16405 CA-116, Guerneville, CA 95446
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Guerneville Taco Truck

    Good for the night before. Open daily 11:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. (its own page, Nov 2026). The page gives no prices, seating or payment details; Sonoma Magazine says cash only, so bring some. Other listings give other addresses for it, so check it’s parked there before a group walks over.

  3. Stumptown Brewery

    A brewpub on River Road, the road the Sweetwater Springs loop comes back to town on.

    • Pub
    • 15045 River Rd, Guerneville, CA 95446
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Stumptown Brewery

    It’s the late one. The kitchen runs 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. Sunday to Thursday and to 10 Friday and Saturday. The pub opens at 11 a.m. every day and stays open until at least 11 p.m. (its own pages, Nov 2026). That’s the latest kitchen we found in town. Its site describes a “huge deck overlooking our 2 acre river front.” It says nothing about bikes. The site is old, so call first: (707) 869-0705.

  4. The Lodge at Dawn Ranch

    A sit-down breakfast, and a dinner for the people who drove up.

    • Californian
    • 16467 CA-116, Guerneville, CA 95446
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about The Lodge at Dawn Ranch

    Breakfast 8 to 11 a.m. Monday to Friday, brunch 8 a.m. to noon Saturday and Sunday. Dinner from 5 p.m., last seating 8 Thursday, Sunday and Monday and 8:30 Friday and Saturday; no dinner Tuesday or Wednesday (its own page, updated Sept 2026). Book dinner: the page says reservations are strongly recommended. It’s the restaurant at Dawn Ranch, the resort. (707) 869-0656.

  5. boon eat + drink

    A small bistro on Main Street with seasonal plates, a burger and a vegan bowl.

    • Californian
    • 16248 Main St, Guerneville, CA 95446
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about boon eat + drink

    Dinner only, from 4 p.m.: to 8 Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, to 9 Friday and Saturday; closed Monday and Tuesday (its own page, Nov 2026). No reservations and walk-in parties of six at most, so a big group splits up or goes elsewhere. Mains $26–$45 (Nov 2026). 707-869-0780.

  6. Blue Heron Restaurant and Tavern

    A tavern with a seafood kitchen in Duncans Mills, where the King Ridge and Sonoma Coast routes both pass.

    • Seafood
    • 25275 Steelhead Blvd, Duncans Mills, CA 95430
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Blue Heron Restaurant and Tavern

    The patio has music on Sundays. The kitchen runs 4:30 to 8 p.m. Tuesday to Friday, noon to 8 Saturday and noon to 7 Sunday; no kitchen hours are posted for Monday. The bar is open daily, from 3 p.m. on weekdays and noon on weekends, to 10 (its own page, Nov 2026). Groups of eight or more need a reservation. (707) 865-2261.
